layout: 정확 작도: 중심 O와 반지름 5의 정구각형. A는 위쪽(90°), B~I는 40° 간격으로 시계 방향. J는 직선 AB와 DC의 실제 교점. 회전 각도 및 O는 내부 구성이고 보이지 않음.

normalizationAndResiduals.normalization: A radius-5 circle centered at hidden O; scale and translation are arbitrary
freeVariables: global rotation, translation, and scale; all nine vertices remain equally spaced by 40 degrees

expectedResiduals.nine_side_lengths_equal: constructed from common center and common radius at 40-degree spacing
expectedResiduals.J_incidence: J is the actual intersection of lines AB and DC

normalizationAndResiduals.tolerance: polar construction is high-precision; angle markings checked against actual derived geometry
